definitions.gloss: eating moderately; dietary restraint; restricting one's diet
definitions.explanation: The practice of deliberately eating less or controlling one's food intake for health reasons.

examples.japanese: ⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{節食|せっしょく}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I'm restricting my diet for my health.

examples.japanese: ⟦{医者|いしゃ}→医者：02847_isha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{節食|せっしょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{勧|すす}められた→勧める：02120_susumeru⟧。

⟦{無理|むり}→無理：01558_muri⟧な{節食|せっしょく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦バランス→バランス：03870_baransu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{心|こころ}がけている→心がける：10015_kokorogakeru⟧。
examples.english: Since extreme dieting is bad for the body, I try to eat a well-balanced diet.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{節|せつ}→節：19359_setsu⟧ (moderation/restraint) and {食|しょく} (eating/food). Implies a deliberate, health-conscious reduction in food intake, not starvation. More formal and measured than ⟦ダイエット→ダイエット：17678_daietto⟧, which in Japanese broadly means any weight-loss effort. {節食|せっしょく} focuses specifically on moderating food quantity.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {節食|せっしょく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to restrict one's diet
- {節食|せっしょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{心|こころ}がける→心がける：10015_kokorogakeru⟧: to make an effort to eat moderately
- ⟦{無理|むり}→無理：01558_muri⟧な{節食|せっしょく}: excessive dietary restriction
- {節食|せっしょく}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧: diet and exercise

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ダイエット→ダイエット：17678_daietto⟧: diet, weight loss — broader, includes exercise and lifestyle changes
- {食事制限|しょくじせいげん}: dietary restriction — more clinical, often medically prescribed
- {減食|げんしょく}: reducing food intake — similar meaning, slightly more direct
- {断食|だんじき}: fasting — complete abstention from food, much more extreme
